_comment: Weapon models (CC0 Quaternius 'Ultimate Gun Pack', assets/weapons/, already in metres). Gameplay numbers (damage, ammo, price) come in Session 6. weapons = the guns the game uses: id, asset (data/assets.json), grip (how it sits in Shoumik's right hand). grips = offset from the right-hand bone of the real model: position in metres, rotation in degrees (x, y, z), scale. Check a grip with: node tools/weapon-grip.js --three <three dir> --out shots.
